description:
The Open Source Cowork Desktop to Unlock Your Exceptional Productivity.

Eigent is the open source cowork desktop application, empowering you to build, manage, and deploy a custom AI workforce that can turn your most complex workflows into automated tasks.
Built on CAMEL-AI's acclaimed open-source project, our system introduces a Multi-Agent Workforce that boosts productivity through parallel execution, customization, and privacy protection.
Eigent v1.0.4
Eigent v1.0.4 introduces a redesigned way to manage Skills and Connectors, while strengthening reliability across multi-turn agent work, workspace checkpoints, and app shutdown.
The new management experience makes resources easier to browse, inspect, and configure, while a focused set of fixes helps Tasks complete more predictably.
Highlights
- Redesigned Skills and Connectors
  - Browse and manage Skills in a library-style dashboard with dedicated detail views.
  - Inspect source and access details, enable or disable Skills, and review their files from one place.
  - Manage Connectors through a clearer collection, discovery, and detail flow.
- A more consistent Home and Settings experience
  - Use shared layouts, breadcrumbs, sidebars, and content rails across Home, Skills, and Connectors.
  - Navigate clearer lists, empty states, and Space detail views.
- More reliable multi-turn agent work
  - Preserve trusted agent instructions across chained Responses API turns.
  - Avoid duplicated prompt content while keeping Prompt Guard protections in place.
  - Improve compatibility with tools that use dynamic parameter schemas.
- Safer Git-backed Spaces
  - Treat nested Git repositories as independent boundaries during workspace checkpoints.
  - Complete parent checkpoints without altering nested repositories or their committed content.
- Clearer connector behavior
  - Keep Web search discoverable when it still needs configuration.
  - Present Slack through the appropriate connector path when Connector Gateway is enabled, while preserving local-only compatibility.
Reliability and UX improvements
- Quit cleanly when the final app window closes and shut down the local backend correctly across platforms.
- Give stopped preview servers more time to release workspace writes and complete checkpointing before Tasks finish.
- Improve generated-web Task completion and background-process cleanup.
- Preserve compatibility for existing saved Workers, Slack triggers, and local-only integrations.
Compatibility
Existing Spaces, Sessions, Tasks, Skill settings, saved Workers, and connector configurations remain available after upgrading. No additional configuration is required for the default v1.0.4 experience.
Full changelog: https://github.com/eigent-ai/eigent/compare/v1.0.3...v1.0.4
